paragraphs: Friend, here's what I take from these four chariots. The whole earth is in motion, and none of it is running loose. The angel says these are "the four spirits of heaven, going forth from their station before the Lord of all the earth" (Zechariah 6:5). They don't wander out on their own. They go out from His presence, and they go when He sends them.

Look at what the LORD says as the strong horses are eager to go: "Go and patrol the earth." And then, "So they patrolled the earth" (Zechariah 6:7). Nobody argues, nobody stalls, and nobody needs a second reminder. Then He says those going to the land of the north "have given rest to My Spirit in the land of the north" (Zechariah 6:8). I think that tells us His work out there gets done, and He is the one who tells Zechariah so.

So why does this matter to you, baker? Some days the world feels like a kitchen with nobody in charge, and the timer's going off and everything's smoking. This vision says the Lord of all the earth is still the one sending, still the one watching, and still the one with the final word. That's why my ovens stay ready. I don't know the day, but I know who's running the bakery. The story isn't over yet, and neither is the teaching.
